changes: exported from Onshape as GLB (1,515,782 triangles, 15 plain colours, no textures); the fairing and payload adapter are not part of the export
the maker's name, mark and lettering recoloured to the surrounding surface, then every colour removed
reduced to 18,978 triangles in Blender 5.3 (planar dissolve, then edge collapse) and turned Y up
scaled evenly to the published 8.05 m height and stood on the origin with one plain grey material, by finish-model.mjs

simplifications: The shape is a community CAD model by David Nagy, not the maker's data; we have not compared it with the maker's drawings.
Scaled evenly from the CAD file's 8.005 m to the published 8.05 m (about 0.6 percent).
Width and depth come from the CAD model, scaled: 4.74 m at the rim of the top deck, 4.30 m across the landing leg foot pads; no published figure for either was found.
At the published 8.05 m height the CAD body is about 3.8 to 4.0 m across, wider than the published 3.08 m diameter: the community model's proportions differ from the published figures.
Fairing and payload adapter not included; detail reduced to keep under 20,000 triangles.
All colours removed; no names, marks or lettering; one plain grey material.

finishing.material: one neutral material; every texture, image, UV coordinate, per-vertex colour and original material removed
